title: A flat map surjective on spectra is faithfully flat
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. If the induced map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], on points the map of prime spectra $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is surjective, then $R\to S$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
